name: Slack
_comment: client_id is the public id of the Fused Slack app (made from manifest.json: PKCE on, public distribution on). It is not a secret (RFC 8252: a native app cannot keep one; PKCE + loopback redirect are the locks). FUSED_RENDER_CONNECT_SLACK_CLIENT_ID overrides it, and Advanced on the card takes the id of your own app made from the same manifest. There is no client secret anywhere.
privacy: Sign-in and every call go straight from this computer to Slack. The token stays on this computer. Fused runs no server in this flow.
